clips.title: The story
paras: Lieutenant Doren calls upon you to deliver the final strike against Colonel Kurzen and his inner guard. You are sent into the Stockpile to eliminate the rogue commander and his remaining leaders to secure the Rebel Camp's survival.

Lieutenant Doren and his band of defectors have reached the climax of their struggle against their former commander. Following the suppression of Kurzen's elite specialists, Doren recognizes that the rebel forces will never truly be safe while Kurzen retains control of his jungle redoubt. He directs you into the Stockpile cave, where Kurzen directs his forces alongside his subchiefs and elites.

To permanently end the threat, Doren asks for conclusive proof of Kurzen's downfall by demanding the rogue colonel's head, along with the defeat of his elites and subchiefs. Entering the cave to face Kurzen's leadership offers the rebels their sole prospect of breathing easier amid the perils of northern Stranglethorn.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You have proven yourself time and again, and your resourcefulness seems to rival even that of Kurzen himself. You may be the salvation of our band of rebels...if you can pit yourself against Kurzen and prevail!
He commands his men from deep within the Stockpile. You must enter that cave, brave through his defenders, and face Kurzen and his leaders.
Farewell, friend. My hope, and the fate of my men, go with you.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Dare I hope that Kurzen and his defenders are dead, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: I dared not believe the reports, but you bring us proof that...Kurzen and his leaders are defeated. You have saved us!
These jungles are filled with menaces of all types, but none had the cruel intellect of Kurzen. We may all breathe easier now that he is gone.
